extracted_code:
noncomputable def VTask.binaryRec {motive : ℕ → Sort u} (zero : motive 0) (bit : (b : Bool) → (n : ℕ) → motive n → motive (Nat.bit b n)) (n : ℕ) : motive n :=
  match n with
  | 0 => zero
  | Nat.succ n =>
    let rec aux (motive : ℕ → Sort u) (n : ℕ) : motive n :=
      match n with
      | 0 => zero
      | Nat.succ n =>
        let b := n % 2 = 1
        let m := n / 2
        bit b m (aux motive m)
    aux motive n
